# Abderrahmane Wardi

### Professor · PhD Candidate · Biomedical Engineering

I am **Abderrahmane Wardi**, a Professor of Industrial Engineering Sciences and a PhD candidate at **École Nationale Supérieure d'Arts et Métiers (ENSAM), Mohammed V University in Rabat, Morocco**.

My academic work combines **engineering education, biomedical signal processing, embedded systems, TinyML, and artificial intelligence**.

My current research focuses on intelligent and resource-efficient systems for **ECG signal processing and classification**, particularly their deployment on embedded platforms.

## Research & Projects

My research activities focus on intelligent biomedical systems and the deployment of lightweight machine-learning models on resource-constrained embedded platforms.

Current topics include:

- TinyML for ECG beat classification
- Embedded ECG monitoring
- Biomedical signal processing
- Intelligent biomedical instrumentation
- Edge AI for healthcare applications
